name: AI Search
description: Adds an AI search bar to the Jellyfin web client. Ask in natural language and get titles from your own library, personalized to your watch history. Works with any OpenAI-compatible model, with a local or remote retrieval source.
overview: AI natural-language search & recommendations from your own library.

versions.changelog: One unified setup: a chat endpoint plus a local or remote retrieval source (replaces the old Direct/Platform modes). New: search without a language model, returning retrieval matches ranked by relevance with no per-result reasons. Embedding model is now a dropdown, and endpoints are configured per capability.
Show more now returns new titles instead of repeating the first results. Recommendations no longer come back empty on reasoning models.
Fixed a bug when choosing TV or Movies in platform mode.
